notes: Marrow & Tide, a fictional 28-seat wood-fired coastal kitchen in Rockport, Maine. Includes a 33-item searchable menu with dietary filters, a reservation flow with live availability and calendar export, a persistent larder basket with pickup checkout, real opening-hours status with special-hours handling, an SVG-illustrated room and dishes, generated ambient sound, and responsive/reduced-motion support. Reservation and pickup availability are simulated client-side; no real orders or bookings are transmitted.
